title: CTAB Mix Preparation
author: Andrew Baker
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.dyt7wm

steps.title: Dissolve CTAB
steps.instruction: Dissolve 0.75 g cetyltrimethylammonium bromide (CTAB) in approximately 20 mL Milli‑Q water.

steps.title: Add NaCl solution
steps.instruction: Add 12.5 mL of 4 M sodium chloride (NaCl) solution to the mixture.

steps.title: Add carrier tRNA
steps.instruction: Add 75 µL of E. coli tRNA at 20 mg/mL (carrier nucleic acid) to the mixture.

steps.title: Adjust final volume
steps.instruction: Bring the total volume up to 50 mL with Milli‑Q water.
